title: Grid Code & Standards Viewer
description: Browse and cross-reference UK and EU grid codes, ENA EREC documents, and connection-process artefacts without juggling PDF tabs. Faceted filter (project type × study type × topic × jurisdiction), split-pane viewer with the PDF on the left and related clauses on the right, per-clause permalinks. Link-only for GB documents (NESO Grid Code, EREC G99, Distribution Code etc.) per publisher T&Cs; EU Network Codes can be hosted locally and full-text searched.

blocks.text: Engineers writing simulation reports or compliance studies under EREC G99 typically need to flip between the Grid Code, EREC G99, EREC G5/5, EREC P28, the Distribution Code, and the underlying EU Network Codes (RfG/DCC/HVDC) for a single piece of work. This tool puts a curated catalogue of those documents behind a single faceted filter — pick your project type (G98, G99 Type A/B/C/D, BESS, syncgen, PPM, HVDC) and study type (FRT, harmonics, reactive capability etc.), and the relevant documents and clauses surface together with hand-curated cross-references.

Use ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows/Linux) to open the search palette from anywhere inside the tool. Searches over document titles, clause IDs and clause summaries — type 'ECC.6.3.7' or 'fault ride through' and hit Enter.

License buckets shown alongside each document — link-only means the source PDF can only be viewed at the publisher (ENA/NESO/DCode T&Cs prohibit redistribution); hostable-eu means the PDF is served locally (EU Network Codes under Decision 2011/833/EU); paywalled means the standard is metadata-only (IEEE 1547, IEC 61400, VDE-AR-N). Always verify against the current published version before submitting compliance evidence.

Versions drift. NESO Grid Code revises monthly, EREC G99 and the Distribution Code yearly. The catalogue tracks current revisions but the in-tool 'Last updated' badge reflects when the catalogue entry was refreshed, not necessarily the publisher's latest. When in doubt, click through to the publisher landing page.
